narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Any five arms give five angles of symmetry, whatever the gaps between them.
<bookmark mark='uneven'/>Draw five arms with uneven gaps, and turn them so one arm lands on the next.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The other arms miss their places, so the gaps must be equal, and the bubble is struck.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says any five arms will do; a figure with five arms and uneven gaps is turned, and the red arm lands between two arms; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Equal arms need equal gaps. Each gap is a full turn shared by the arms.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Ten equal arms are drawn around a centre. What is the gap between neighbouring arms?
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows: equal arms need equal gaps; gap = full turn shared by the number of arms; then Your turn: 10 equal arms around a centre
